content.text:
**DoonProperties.in** is set up as a static Dehradun property classifieds site with the file layout you asked for.

## File structure

```
virudoonproperties/
├── index.html
├── property-details.html
├── post-ad.html
├── css/style.css
└── js/main.js
```

## What’s included

**Homepage (`index.html`)**
- Hero with search: “Search properties in Dehradun”
- Category chips: All, House, Apartment, Plot, Commercial, PG
- Responsive property grid (1 → 2 → 3 → 4 columns)
- Cards: image placeholder, price, title, location, beds/baths/area, For Sale/Rent badge

**8 sample listings** across:
Rajpur Road, Mussoorie Road, Ballupur, Sahastradhara Road, Vasant Vihar, Clement Town, Dalanwala, Jakhan

**Property details (`property-details.html?id=1`)**
- Full description, specs, contact, Call Now
- Loaded from `main.js` via URL `id`

**Post an ad (`post-ad.html`)**
- Form: type, sale/rent, price, location, beds, baths, area, description, contact, image upload (preview)
- New ads saved in `localStorage` and shown on the homepage

**Design**
- OLX-style white cards, rounded corners, light shadows
- Primary `#2E7D32`, secondary `#FFA000`, background `#F5F5F5`
- Inter + Poppins (Google Fonts)

## How to run

Open `index.html` in a browser (double-click or use Live Server). Click any card for details, or use **Post an Ad** to add a listing.

**Try:** search “Rajpur”, filter by **Plot**, or open `property-details.html?id=4` for the Sahastradhara commercial shop.

content.text:
Occupancy is now limited to **PG/Guesthouse** listings only. Here’s what changed:

## Changes

### `js/main.js`
- Replaced `pgSharing` with **`occupancy`** (`"Single"`, `"Sharing"`, or `"Both"`) on PG listings only.
- Added `isPgListing()`, `getOccupancyLabel()`, and `normalizeProperty()` so sale/rent listings never keep an occupancy field (including old `localStorage` data).
- **4 PG samples updated:**
  | Location      | Occupancy        |
  |---------------|------------------|
  | Clement Town  | Sharing          |
  | Dalanwala     | Single           |
  | Ballupur      | Both → Single/Sharing |
  | Jakhan        | Sharing          |
- **Cards:** occupancy badge only on PG (`Single`, `Sharing`, or `Single/Sharing`); no occupancy in card details for other types.
- **Details:** “Occupancy” spec only when `type === "pg"`; bedrooms/bathrooms hidden for PG.
- **Prices:** sale and regular rent show no occupancy; PG still shows `₹X,XXX / month (single/sharing)` in the price line.

### `post-ad.html`
- Occupancy dropdown (Single / Sharing / Both) is inside `#pg-fields` and only visible when listing type is **PG / Guesthouse**.

### `css/style.css`
- Added `.badge-occupancy` for PG occupancy badges on cards.

### `property-details.html` & `index.html`
- No structural changes; behavior is driven by `main.js`.

**Tip:** If you still see occupancy on old listings, clear site data for this domain or run in the console: `localStorage.removeItem('doonProperties')` to drop outdated stored ads.

- **Occupancy:** `display: block` only when listing type is `pg`; otherwise `display: none`.
- **`name` attribute:** Added on occupancy only for PG; removed for Sale/Rent so FormData won’t include it.
- **Property type:** Filters options by listing type:

  - **Rent:** House, Apartment, Commercial  
  - **PG:** PG, Guesthouse  
- **Bedrooms/Bathrooms:** Hidden (`display: none`) for PG; shown as a grid for Sale/Rent.
- **Submit:** Saves `occupancy` only when `listingType === "pg"`; `normalizeProperty()` still strips it from other listings in storage.

content.text:
Your DoonProperties.in site has been upgraded to a more premium look while keeping **Buy/Rent tabs**, **filters**, **PG occupancy rules**, and **post-ad** behavior intact.

## Visual upgrades

### Hero (`index.html` + `css/premium.css`)
- Full-width Dehradun hills background (Unsplash + optional local `images/hero-dehradun.jpg`)
- Dark gradient overlay for readable text
- Floating search bar animation
- CTAs: **Explore Properties** and **Post Free Ad**
- Font Awesome icons in header/nav

### New homepage sections
- **Why Choose Us** — 4 icon cards (Trusted, Best Prices, Verified, Free Posting)
- **Animated stats** — 500+ sold, 1000+ clients, 50+ localities, live listings
- **Locality chips** — Rajpur, Mussoorie Road, Ballupur, etc. (click to search & scroll to listings)
- **CTA banner** before footer

### Property cards (`js/main.js`)
- Real **Unsplash** photos per type (house, apartment, plot, commercial, PG)
- **Image slider** on cards (prev/next + dots when multiple photos)
- **Featured** badge on premium listings
- **Wishlist** heart (toggle only, no backend)
- Larger price with rupee icon
- **Amenity icons** (parking, security, pool, Wi‑Fi, etc.)
- Hover: card lift + image zoom
- Skeleton shimmer while images load
- Gradient + FA icon fallback if an image fails

### Details page
- Photo gallery slider
- Call + **WhatsApp** buttons
- FA icons for location, price, phone

### Images folder
- `images/README.md` — usage notes  
- `images/download-images.ps1` — run to save 14 stock photos locally  

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File images/download-images.ps1
```

### Files touched
- `index.html` — new sections + FA + `premium.css`
- `css/premium.css` — new premium styles
- `js/main.js` — images, sliders, counters, locality search, amenities
- `property-details.html` & `post-ad.html` — FA + premium CSS

Open `index.html` in a browser (with internet for Unsplash images). Use **BUY/RENT**, locality chips, card sliders, and wishlist hearts to try the new UI.
